title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #18

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which action shows self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Pushing in a queue
   B. Shouting
   C. Taking others' things
   D. Waiting for your turn

2. What is a good rule when you are alone with people? (1 mark)
   A. Be careful and stay in open places
   B. Share private pictures
   C. Accept lifts from strangers
   D. Go to hidden places

3. Why should we help promptly? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody needs help
   B. Delay is better
   C. Needs may be urgent
   D. Helping is a waste

4. Which is an example of helping a classmate? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing at him
   B. Hiding your pencil
   C. Sharing your pencil
   D. Telling lies

5. Who baptised Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Stephen
   C. Paul
   D. John the Baptist

6. Which verse says that all peoples on earth will be blessed through Abraham? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Genesis 12:3
   D. John 3:16

7. What does responsibility mean? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving jobs to others
   B. Being lazy
   C. Doing your duties and caring for what belongs to you
   D. Breaking things

8. Who should give permission before you use an app? (1 mark)
   A. Your parent or guardian
   B. Nobody
   C. A stranger
   D. A friend

9. A classmate is sitting alone and looks sad. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Tell others to avoid them
   B. Ignore them
   C. Laugh at them
   D. Sit with them and kindly ask what is wrong

10. What is an attribute of God? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. A holiday
   C. A quality that describes what God is like
   D. A kind of building

11. Which action shows care for school property? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping toilets clean
   B. Writing on desks
   C. Breaking chairs
   D. Wasting water

12. Which story is a fable about lying but is not in the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Zacchaeus
   B. Joseph
   C. The shepherd boy and the wolf
   D. Balaam

13. Which number can children call for help in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. 116
   B. 66
   C. 200
   D. 10

14. What did Bartimaeus do when Jesus called him? (1 mark)
   A. Ran away
   B. Stayed sitting
   C. Threw his cloak aside and jumped up
   D. Hid

15. Which fruit means being gentle and careful with people's feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Gentleness
   C. Pride
   D. Envy

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain why Christians should help those in need. (3 marks)

17. Describe three steps for making a right decision. (3 marks)

18. Explain how the books of the Old Testament are grouped, giving the number of books in each group. (5 marks)

19. State two things the angel Gabriel said about the child that Mary would bear. (2 marks)

20. Give two examples from the Bible of people who disobeyed God. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Waiting for your turn
   Waiting is self-control.

2. A — Be careful and stay in open places
   Safe places and caution protect you.

3. C — Needs may be urgent
   Quick help reduces suffering.

4. C — Sharing your pencil
   Sharing meets a need.

5. D — John the Baptist
   Matthew 3:13-17 says John baptised Jesus.

6. C — Genesis 12:3
   Genesis 12:3 contains this promise.

7. C — Doing your duties and caring for what belongs to you
   Responsibility means doing what is expected.

8. A — Your parent or guardian
   Ask an adult first.

9. D — Sit with them and kindly ask what is wrong
   Kindness and listening help a sad friend.

10. C — A quality that describes what God is like
   An attribute is a quality that describes someone.

11. A — Keeping toilets clean
   Cleanliness respects property.

12. C — The shepherd boy and the wolf
   The boy who cried wolf is a fable.

13. A — 116
   Childline Kenya.

14. C — Threw his cloak aside and jumped up
   He threw off his cloak and came to Jesus.

15. B — Gentleness
   Gentleness is caring.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus taught it; it shows love; it makes the community stronger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stop and think, ask if it pleases God, pray, ask advice, choose the right thing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: Law has 5 books, history has 12 books, poetry and wisdom has 5 books, and the prophets have 17 books. Together they make 39 books.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each group with number, and 1 mark for the total.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: He will be great, He will be called Son of the Most High, He will have the throne of David, His kingdom will never end. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid statement.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adam and Eve, Jonah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.
